title: Sparkasse
description: Sparkasse's official colour manual defines Sparkassen-Rot (#ff0000) with white (#ffffff), black (#000000), and greys (#666666, #d9d9d9), plus secondary yellow (#ffc900), orange (#ff8f00), violet (#9b348e), blues (#2c57d2, #00acd3), and greens (#009864, #8cd000). Hex values are published in the Sparkasse Farben guidelines (HKS/Pantone/RGB/Hex).
